title: MacNeal–Harder straight beam
sentence: A short cantilever meshed as six regular quad elements — the classic shear-locking sensitivity check.
theory: Six elements along a beam of aspect ratio 30 is deliberately too coarse: a fully integrated linear quad locks in shear and returns a fraction of $0.1081$. Passing this needs a formulation that removes the parasitic shear — incompatible modes, reduced integration with hourglass control, or quadratic elements.
